mapper.select: select tws.title as schedule_name, tws.schedule_id as schedule_id, trt.template_id as template_id, tws.workout_date as schedule_date, tws.status as scheduleStatus, tws.memo as memo from tb_workout_schedule tws left join tb_routine_template trt on tws.template_id = trt.template_id where login_id = #{login_id}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_workout_schedule(title, login_id, workout_date, status, memo, created_at, template_id) values (#{title}, #{loginId}, #{workoutDate}, #{status}, #{memo}, NOW(), #{templateId})
mapper.update: update tb_workout_schedule set title = #{title}, status = #{status}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = NOW() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
